verdict.rationale: Data-use and training-opt-out posture is a fair question for a vendor AI and robotics platform. However, the evidence pack contains no documented policy, setting or guarantee that keeps user data out of model training. Self-hosted options such as Docker, pip installs and headless operation are adjacent deployment features, not a documented training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
